quarterly_data.quarter: IREN press release: IREN's 2GW Sweetwater Hub Included as Base Load in ERCOT (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IREN's 2GW Sweetwater Hub - Sweetwater 1 (1,400MW) and Sweetwater 2 (600MW), part of its >5GW global data center development portfolio - has been conditionally included in ERCOT's Batch Zero process as Base Load. At Sweetwater 1 the high-voltage substation was energized earlier this year and construction of 300MW (gross) of data center capacity continues, with delivery targeted for Q4 2027. Additional large-scale projects in IREN's broader pipeline were also included in Batch Zero; IREN will add them to its announced development portfolio only after the relevant grid connection agreements are executed. ERCOT's classifications remain conditional and subject to ongoing approval processes.
quarterly_data.figure: 2GW Sweetwater Hub (1,400MW + 600MW) conditionally Base Load in Batch Zero; 300MW (gross) at Sweetwater 1 targeted Q4 2027
